create_epic_kitchen_dataset: create an EpicKitchenDataset instance with video info, actions CSV, clip sampler, and data manifest paths
sample_video_clip: sample a video clip by index from the EpicKitchenDataset returning video tensor, audio, and actions
define_action_data: define an ActionData dataclass with participant ID, video ID, verb, noun, timestamps, and frame ranges
get_action_start_time: get the start time in seconds from an ActionData instance using the start_time property
get_dataset_length: get the total number of video clips in the EpicKitchenDataset using the length method
